product_wide_rationale: Governs which program every Go-core host invocation runs and how the registry the session verifies stays the one the command resolves. It binds the operator surface, the agent surface, and the session start path, so no single runtime Domain owns it.
summary: session-prepare runs one bounded bare registry probe of the calling host in the claimed worktree under the calling host's inherited environment, so the verified registry is the one the calling session resolves with, and probe refusals are typed. The configured launch command, its option, and every Go launch obligation are retired; Concord launches nothing.
title: Session context probes the calling host once
